definitions.explanation: To make something clear or understandable by describing it in detail.

examples.japanese: もう{一度|いちど}{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain it one more time.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{説明|せつめい}してくれた。
examples.english: The teacher explained it for me.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}するまでもないことだ。
examples.english: It goes without saying. / It needs no explanation.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{理由|りゆう}を{詳|くわ}しく{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: She explained the reason in detail.

examples.japanese: {分|わ}かりやすく{説明|せつめい}するのは{難|むずか}しいが、とても{大切|たいせつ}なことだ。
examples.english: Explaining things clearly is difficult, but it's very important.

notes:
To make something clear by describing it in detail. One of the most commonly used する verbs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{説明|せつめい}する: to explain ~
- 〜について{説明|せつめい}する: to explain about ~
- {分|わ}かりやすく{説明|せつめい}する: to explain clearly
- {詳|くわ}しく{説明|せつめい}する: to explain in detail
- {説明|せつめい}するまでもない: goes without saying

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {説明書|せつめいしょ}: instruction manual
- {説明会|せつめいかい}: briefing session, information session
- {説明|せつめい}{不足|ぶそく}: insufficient explanation
- {説明|せつめい}{責任|せきにん}: accountability (duty to explain)

NOUN FORM:
{説明|せつめい} can also be used as a standalone noun: {説明|せつめい}を{求|もと}める (to demand an explanation), {説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}く (to listen to an explanation).
